content:
matt (finance): Heads-up: we9re changing how short, high-throughput usage is reflected on invoices. Starting 2026-06-01 UTC, metering will record minute-level buckets rather than daily averages for burst attribution.

omar (billing): TL;DR: no pricing change. We9re changing attribution granularity: usage will be assigned to the minute it occurred (minute_bucket_ts) and invoice exports will surface those minute line items. For rate-limited customers we9ll apply a 1-hour lookback smoothing for throttling behavior.

sophia (ops): Context: customers with occasional heavy bursts reported surprise invoices because a few heavy minutes were averaged across a quiet day. This makes cost signal reflect actual traffic patterns and enables minute-aware routing and fallback policies.

matt (finance): Effects to highlight: 
- Free credits: consumed against minute-level usage first, so a single heavy minute can exhaust credits faster than before.
- Startup promos issued before 2025-12-31: unused credits get a 90-day roll-forward then sunset; support will email affected accounts.

alyssa (support): Support snippet: "We now attribute high-velocity usage per minute; short bursts will show as minute-level line items but throttling smoothing covers a 1-hour window." Use that in customer replies.

omar (billing): Engineering note: billing events will emit `minute_bucket_ts` and a `peak_flag`. CSV invoice export fields: `customer_id,minute_bucket_ts,tokens,route,model,unit_price_usd`.

sophia (ops): Ops note: Dedicated pools can opt into "minute-aware" fairness. Default smoothing remains for 30 days post-launch.

matt (finance): Committed Dedicated customers: no change to commit math; overage calc unchanged, just visibility changes on line items.

omar (billing): Opt-out path: 90-day console/API toggle to enable "legacy daily smoothing". New toggles close for new accounts after 2026-08-31; existing opt-ins honored until renewal.

billing-bot: deploy:billing-metering-service v2.14 promoted at 2165002600 10: new minute_bucket_ts emission ON.

alyssa (support): Suggested canned reply for spikes: "We moved to minute-level attribution to improve accuracy. If you9d like a review or temporary legacy smoothing, send account id + invoice range to support."

matt (finance): Rollout checklist: blog & support article 2026-05-05; console banner 2026-05-10; customer emails 2026-05-12; telemetry review 2026-06-08.

omar (billing): Action items: publish CSV spec & FAQ by 2026-04-30; DevEx add toggle + UI by 2026-05-08; Support prepare macro & playbook by 2026-05-05.

sophia (ops): Important: invoice export cardinality increases. Data warehouse consumers should expect more rows; include partitioning/retention guidance in docs.

alyssa (support): Will add minute_bucket_ts troubleshooting section to playbook.

matt (finance): For legal/enterprise concerns DM me or tag @omar. We9ll process exemptions where contracts require.

omar (billing): If invoices look materially different, file in #eng-releases and tag `billing-metering-service` + `priority:high`.

sophia (ops): Internal rollout doc: https://redwood-internal.docs/runbooks/billing-minute-pacing (internal). Please comment.

alyssa (support): :thumbsup:

matt (finance): We'll host an AMA in #announcements-support on 2026-05-15. Closing thread.
